name: Tokyo Ohka Kogyo Co., Ltd.
summary: Tokyo Ohka Kogyo Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells chemical products and process equipment in Japan and internationally. The company offers g/i-Line, KrF excimer laser, ArF excimer laser, and EUV photoresists; wet etching and deep dry etching resist; developer and rinse, and stripping solution; thinner; adhesion enhancing, DSA, reflective multilayer, and file formation materials. It provides semiconductor packaging manufacturing products, including lift-off, bump formation, redistribution layer resist, protective coating materials, and adhesives; CMOS sensors and driving support system; and transparent materials and photosensitive permanent films.
